scope: Every non-text source candidate file; node_modules, .git and generated dist excluded. Also inventories embedded game-icons paths.
excluded_media: No audio, video, original source purchase archives, old Git history, .backup or DungeonCrawler01 bytes in candidate source.
limitations: Files were matched to local license/provenance/pin evidence; original paid collection archive was not freshly accessed or rebuilt.
Font files lack an upstream hash pin in the source repository.
MIT applies to original code/docs, not a relicensing of CC0/OFL/CC-BY dependencies.
